title: Adapter secrets
description: The body of the signed 200 answer to the signed GET /v1/adapter/secrets, application/json: the secrets the adapter stored with its latest POST /v1/adapter/secrets (adapter-secrets.schema.json), sealed to the adapter's access key. The adapter reads them when it starts, before it reaches its source or serves a call. sealed is adapter-secrets-plaintext.schema.json, sealed with HPKE base mode, the suite x25519-sha256-aes256gcm, to the access key the request verified under, with a fresh ephemeral key for each answer. The recipient's X25519 public key is that access key's Ed25519 public key converted to its Montgomery u-coordinate, as Forager converts it for the secrets answer of its contract. info is qory adapter secrets v1, a zero byte, the suite's three ids 0x0020, 0x0001 and 0x0002 as u16 big-endian, and lp(access key id); aad is lp(adapter id) and lp(access key id). lp is a u16 big-endian length, then the bytes. Neither has a run id or a run configuration digest: the secrets belong to the adapter, not to a run. The adapter builds info and aad from the id it is enrolled as and the access key it signed the request with, never from the answer, and refuses an answer whose access_key_id is not that key's id or whose seal does not open. When the adapter has stored no secret, the plaintext lists none. The GET is signed with the adapter's access key, X-Qory-Timestamp included, and the answer under the control plane's server key, as definitions.schema.json describes; the adapter checks the answer under a server key it pinned at enrolment before opening it. The answer is bound to the signature of the GET, and each GET of one instance has an X-Qory-Timestamp later than that of the GET before it (definitions.schema.json), so a delivery answer bound to one GET verifies for no later GET and cannot be replayed to it. The answer names the revision it was built for in revision, inside the signed body, and the adapter refuses an answer whose revision is not the revision it implements. The adapter keeps the values in memory alone, and never logs one. The adapter refuses a member this schema does not define.

version.description: The document format. The adapter refuses a version it does not read.

revision.description: The contract revision the control plane built the answer for, the one the request's X-Qory-Contract-Version named. The adapter refuses an answer whose revision is not the revision it implements.

sealed.description: The secrets, sealed to the adapter's access key.

access_key_id.description: The access key the values are sealed to, the one the request verified under.

ct.description: The ciphertext of adapter-secrets-plaintext.schema.json, followed by the 16-byte tag.
